features.title: Choose your agent
features.description: On first boot, Omarchy invites you to set up a default agent. Pick your favorite, sign in, and put it to work on your computer.

features.title: Make sense of a crash
features.description: When an app crashes, click the notification to send your agent on the case. It can examine the crash dump, diagnose what went wrong, and help report the bug.

features.title: Make it your own
features.description: Omarchy ships with skills to help your agent make apps, plugins, and themes. Describe what you want, try what it builds, and share it with everyone.

tools.title: Your editor, integrated
tools.description: Neovim is the default, with VSCode, Cursor, Zed, Sublime Text, Helix, Vim, and Emacs ready to install. Pick your favorite and make it the system-wide default.

tools.title: Your stack, ready to go
tools.description: Install Ruby on Rails, Laravel, Node.js, and a long list of other development environments from the Omarchy menu. Mise handles language versions, so each project can use what it needs.

tools.title: Four terminals, one choice
tools.description: Foot is the fast, lightweight default. Prefer Alacritty, Ghostty, or Kitty? All four are integrated, and switching your default keeps the same keyboard shortcuts working.

games.name: Steam
games.alt: Steam showing its game store on Omarchy
games.description: Your PC gaming library, right at home on Linux. Steam and Proton bring a huge world of modern games to Omarchy.

games.name: RetroArch
games.alt: A classic arcade game running with RetroArch’s CRT shader
games.description: Revisit the classics with a full set of emulator cores and the beautiful CRT Royale shader, already configured for that retro look.

games.name: Minecraft
games.description: Build, explore, and make a world of your own. Install Minecraft straight from the Omarchy gaming menu and let your imagination run.
